title: Daily Bike Rental from Avalon
paragraphs: Guests ride a rented bike for the day. A helmet, water, and the bike permit come with the rental. Reserving ahead is how the shop holds a bike. The rental bikes are picked up in Avalon. The ride passes Bike Rentals Helmet and Advanced Booking.

facts.headline: MTB rentals
facts.description: Bike Rentals Helmet, water, and bike permit are included, making your biking experience worry-free. Advanced Booking and Flexible Timing We recommend booking in advance to secure your bike rental. While we suggest at least 12 hours, we will do our best to accommodate your schedule.
facts.detailsText: Pickup Location: 📍 Corner of Sumner & Beacon Street, in front of Vons Market - a central and easy landmark to find. Rental Details: Your bike will be delivered and ready at the time specified in your booking Includes 1 liter of water Helmet provided Interior bike permit included Important Notes: If you plan to bring your own pedals or helmet, please email or message us in advance You are responsible for managing your Free Bicycle reservation - we will show you how to register your ride
